range_summary.text: AI estimate, not solver/GTO: choose a deliberate whole-range check at BB's first flop action. BTN retains AA, AK and stronger Ax coverage; BB has trips and 99 full houses but lacks the exclusive nuts. Checking preserves strong-hand coverage alongside showdown hands, draws and air, avoiding an exposed lead range; allocate nothing to any bet size. Physical blockers affect subsequent decisions but do not change this chosen initial action. Treat supplied weights as each player's own reach, not products of matching combos or a specified joint deal distribution. No prior flop policy or future BTN response is assumed; this simplified recommendation is not an optimality claim.
